title: NetworkConsentChoice
description: network.consent-choice@1 (L24): the body of PUT /api/v1/me/consent/:purpose on OpenVibe.Network — the signed-in person turns a purpose on or off. Turning on records the wording they saw (text_version, which must be the current one) and, for the adults-only purposes, that they confirmed they are 18 or older. Turning off revokes the active choice. An app's choice (app.data) is made on its consent screen, not here.

text_version.description: The wording the page showed. Required to turn on; a stale one is refused (consent.stale_text) so the page shows the new words first.

adult.description: The person confirmed they are 18 or older. Required (true) to turn on face.recognize, ai.train or data.public.
